regular.blocka: Refined, modern interior. Bright apartments with views of mountains, sea and city. It includes a large commercial space that will be loaded with commercial areas of various purposes. Construction of Molly tower will be completed after B tower.
regular.blockb: Comfortable apartment for living. You can choose apartments both on the sunrise side with views of old Batumi, and on the sunny side - with views of new Batumi. P.S. Construction of B tower will be completed first.
regular.blockc: House with modern design, with guaranteed views. From the high floor, a beautiful view of old Batumi will unfold before you. You will be able to see the beauty of the sea, central park, and Lake Nuri from your balcony. Construction will be completed after Molly and B towers.
regular.discover: Multifunctional premium class complex in Batumi
regular.explore: An investment that retains its value. JM Tower is a residential complex based on modern standards, combining quality construction, functional planning and a comfortable environment. It is an ideal solution for both living and investment.
